items.name: Weapon
items.description: Fires automatically at the nearest enemy.

tiers.name: Laser
tiers.description: Fires automatically at the nearest valid target. Enemies show health bars.

tiers.name: Enhanced laser
tiers.description: A thicker beam in a new colour. More damage.

tiers.name: Heavy missile
tiers.description: Huge damage with splash, and bonus damage against swarms.

items.name: Claws
items.description: Longer wall runs. Kill any enemy on contact, anywhere. Beat spines and tentacles.

items.name: Juggernaut dash
items.description: Tap to barrel through enemies and obstacles. Recharges after use.

items.name: Magnet
items.description: Pulls in nearby credits on your surface, up to the lanes next to yours.

tiers.name: Magnet
tiers.description: Pulls in credits close to you.

tiers.name: Magnet III
tiers.description: Reaches the lanes on both sides.

items.name: Slow time
items.description: Press E to slow the world for a few seconds. Recharges after use.
